slug: 2025-03-04 Madagascar Launches Digital Readiness Assessment to Tackle Hurdles

facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa reports that the Digital Readiness Assessment launched by the digital ministry and UNDP on 27 February 2025 in Antsirabe serves as the basis for a strategic roadmap; no roadmap text, scope or adoption is stated.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Development, Posts and Telecommunications with UNDP
systems.tiers: national diagnostic on five pillars; launched 27 February 2025
named as highlighting a shortage of about 40,000 specialised technicians

systems.system: programme to train 6,000 people in emerging digital professions
systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Development, Posts and Telecommunications

note: Roadmap fact recorded with class empty: the article states it will follow the assessment but does not describe its scope. The Digital Strategic Plan is named with no dated fact about it.
